description: Use this only when the user asks to change the URL of a stream they already monitor. It replaces that stream's URL; recognition continues on the new URL under the same radio_id.

radio_id.description: The integer that identifies the stream on this account (see list_streams)

url.description: Stream URL (Icecast, HLS, DASH, m3u/m3u8, ...) or a shortcut: twitch:<channel name>, youtube:<video id>, youtube-ch:<channel id>

name: update_stream_url
title: Change a stream's URL
